headline: Single-cell probe quantification and assumption-checked differential expression workflows
label: Computational Tools For Omics
summary: Experimental and analytical omics workflows are being rebuilt with computational tools that report runtime, assumption-compatibility, or randomization safeguards.
synthesis: The dominant thread is tooling that makes omics analysis or experimental workflows more efficient or more defensible before results are generated. simpleaf is extended to quantify probe-based multiplexed single-cell data at sub-gene resolution, reporting lower runtime and memory than cyto and Cell Ranger. DE-Rigor-Agent addresses a different stage: an LLM-agent workflow that screens six bulk RNA-seq differential expression methods for assumption compatibility before any is executed. WorkListGenerator targets proteomics study design, structuring project metadata and block-randomizing LC-MS run order. The new element across these is that each encodes a specific procedural safeguard, whether computational efficiency, assumption checking, or randomization, into the workflow itself. The items are heterogeneous in data type and pipeline stage, so the shared focus is methodological infrastructure rather than a single algorithmic advance.
